lines.text: The kings of the earth take their stand against the LORD and His Anointed One, wanting to break Their chains.
The One enthroned in heaven laughs, then rebukes the kings in His anger and terrifies them in His fury.
The LORD says He has installed His King on Sinai, His holy mountain, and calls Him His Son.
The LORD says the Son will break the nations with Aaron's rod and shatter them like pottery.
The kings must serve the LORD with fear and kiss the Son; all who take refuge in Him are blessed.
